content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What is Spring Data JPA?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Spring Data JPA simplifies data access in Spring applications by providing a high-level abstraction over JPA (Java Persistence API). It reduces boilerplate code required to implement data access layers, allowing developers to focus on business logic. It offers features like repository interfaces, automatic query generation, and auditing."}]
